title: Where's the rest of it?
text:
Where's the rest of it?. This bag is only about 7in x 16in. I'm not exactly sure what pillow they expect you to fill with this extremely small amount, unless it's maybe a Barbie Doll pillow. The only reason I gave it a 5 star in comfort is because I love my shredded memory foam pillow from Bare Home. Which sadly is no longer available. This is definitely NOT worth $18.99. I am very disappointed in this product.

Update: As it turns out, this was enough to fluff my pillow back up. I still don't think it was worth the price.
